mentions.name: CopDB
mentions.description: CopDB is a database cataloging police officer records across jurisdictions. It started with Utah and is expanding to add jurisdictions outside Utah, with plans for mass imports from select other data sources.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on CopDB, started adding jurisdictions outside of Utah and were thinking about doing some mass imports from select other data sources.
